en.headline: Police charge 38-year-old man with nine offences over fatal Prat Avenue crash
en.dek: The driver is to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on Tuesday morning on charges including dangerous driving causing death and driving while disqualified.
body: Police said a 38-year-old man surnamed Ngai has been provisionally charged with nine offences following the fatal collision on Prat Avenue in Tsim Sha Tsui on Sunday afternoon.

The charges include two counts of careless driving and one count each of dangerous driving causing death, dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm, failing to stop after an accident, failing to report an accident, driving while disqualified, driving without third-party insurance and taking a conveyance without authority.

The case is set for mention at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on the morning of 24 November. Police had earlier arrested the man on suspicion of drink-driving and dangerous driving causing death after the private car mounted the pavement, killing one pedestrian and injuring three others.

zh.headline: 警方就寶勒巷致命車禍暫控38歲男子九項罪名
zh.dek: 司機將於周二早上在九龍城裁判法院提堂，控罪包括危險駕駛引致他人死亡及被取消駕駛資格期間駕駛。
body: 警方表示，38歲姓倪男子因周日下午尖沙咀寶勒巷致命車禍，已被暫控九項罪名。
控罪包括兩項不小心駕駛，以及各一項危險駕駛引致他人死亡、危險駕駛引致他人身體嚴重受傷、發生交通意外後沒有停車、發生意外後沒有報案、被取消駕駛資格期間駕駛、沒有第三者保險而使用車輛及未獲授權而取用運輸工具。
案件將於11月24日早上在九龍城裁判法院提堂。警方早前以涉嫌酒後駕駛及危險駕駛引致他人死亡拘捕該男子，涉事私家車衝上行人路，造成一名途人死亡、三人受傷。
